claims.statement: Management expects this financial year's GMA contribution to be equal to or better than FY 24.
claims.quote: With a reasonable confidence, I can say that, this financial year will be equal to or better than FY '24 GMA contribution.
claims.speaker: management
claims.target: equal to or better than FY '24 GMA contribution

claims.statement: Management believes apparel contribution can go back to pre-COVID levels.
claims.quote: apparel we believe we can go back to the older days of contribution, which was maybe pre-COVID.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects general merchandise to be a larger opportunity in the long term.
claims.quote: the other part is, we see an opportunity in GM, general merchandise to be a larger opportunity in the long term.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management notes it is getting more challenging to maintain a 15% to 20% CAGR growth rate at a pace of 40 stores per annum.
claims.quote: it is getting more and more challenging to maintain a 15% to 20% CAGR growth rate if I continue to grow at only 40 stores per annum.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management hopes for a better rate of store additions in the year after next.
claims.quote: Maybe not this year, but the year after that, I hope that we will have a better rate of store openings, additions.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: Capital commitments have increased to about INR3,600 crores compared to INR2,100 crores earlier.
facts.quote: I see that capital commitments have gone up to about INR3,600 crores versus INR2,100 crores earlier.

facts.statement: DMart Ready reduced pickup locations from 573 last year to 341 this year, shutting down 232 locations.
facts.quote: Percy, we had 573 last year. There are 341 this year, we shut down 232.
